    def test_retained_f_audit_r3_binds_consumed_r411_and_r419_artifacts_and_enforces_post_r419_bounds(self):
        _write(self.packet / 'F_retained_audit.stdout', b'')
        _write(
            self.packet / 'F_retained_audit.stderr',
            b'TERMINAL_REFUSAL: non-normalized dep-info path\n',
        )
        _write(
            self.packet / 'TERMINAL_FAILURE_RETAINED_AUDIT.json',
            runner.json_bytes(
                {
                    'message': 'phase exit nonzero F',
                    'native_outputs_accepted': False,
                    'type': 'Refusal',
                }
            ),
        )
        _write(
            self.packet
            / 'USED_LAUNCH_93645c50dfc6c31930def6df095941fec5f41243bede003b450fe0c3db0cf5f3',
            b'consumed\n',
        )
        _write(self.packet / 'F_retained_audit_r2.stdout', b'')
        _write(
            self.packet / 'F_retained_audit_r2.stderr',
            b'TERMINAL_REFUSAL: run-unit lacks dep-info-associated compiled build script\n',
        )
        _write(
            self.packet / 'TERMINAL_FAILURE_RETAINED_AUDIT_R2.json',
            runner.json_bytes(
                {
                    'message': 'phase exit nonzero F',
                    'native_outputs_accepted': False,
                    'type': 'Refusal',
                }
            ),
        )
        _write(
            self.packet
            / 'USED_LAUNCH_183c19e3bb8f12d2b527d4decdf5844995b4d5bc2e0ff0fb45e5d3c32a579ff8',
            b'consumed\n',
        )
        self.c['total_wall_seconds'] = 6566
        self.c['limits']['F']['wall_seconds'] = 2546

        with patch.object(runner, 'owned_paths'):
            args = runner.sandbox_args(
                self.c, 'F', worker=True, precheck=False, retained_audit='r3'
            )
            self.assertIn('--retained-f-audit-r3', args)
            self.assertNotIn('--retained-f-audit', args)
            self.assertNotIn('--retained-f-audit-r2', args)
            t_idx = args.index(str(self.target))
            self.assertEqual(args[t_idx - 1], '--ro-bind')

        preds = runner.prior_receipts(self.c, 'F', False, retained_audit='r3')
        expected_keys = (
            set(self.PREDECESSORS)
            | set(runner.R411_CONSUMED_PINS)
            | set(runner.R419_R2_CONSUMED_PINS)
        )
        self.assertEqual(set(preds), expected_keys)
        for k, v in {**runner.R411_CONSUMED_PINS, **runner.R419_R2_CONSUMED_PINS}.items():
            self.assertEqual(preds[k], v)

        runner.worker(self.c, 'F', retained_audit='r3')
        self.assertTrue((self.packet / 'F_RETAINED_QUARANTINED_OUTPUTS_R3.json').is_file())
        (self.packet / 'F_RETAINED_QUARANTINED_OUTPUTS_R3.json').unlink()

        # Cumulative F stderr (10237 + 47 + 47 + 75 = 10406) > 10400 refuses before create
        self.c['limits']['F']['stderr_bytes'] = 10400
        with (
            patch.object(runner, 'supervisor_envelope'),
            patch.object(runner, 'bound_identities'),
            patch.object(runner, 'quotas'),
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(runner.Refusal) as ctx:
                runner.launch(self.c, 'F', self.config_sha, retained_audit='r3')
            self.assertIn('log cap hit F stderr', str(ctx.exception))
        self.c['limits']['F']['stderr_bytes'] = 16777216

        # Reset phases/cpu.stat (< 257950306) refuses
        with (
            patch.object(runner, 'supervisor_envelope'),
            patch.object(runner, 'bound_identities'),
            patch.object(runner, 'quotas'),
            patch.object(runner, '_cg_text', return_value='usage_usec 246681730\n'),
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(runner.Refusal) as ctx:
                runner.launch(self.c, 'F', self.config_sha, retained_audit='r3')
            self.assertIn('phase CPU counter reset', str(ctx.exception))

        # Unreduced wall ceiling (> 6566 / 2546) refuses
        self.c['limits']['F']['wall_seconds'] = 2566
        with self.assertRaises(runner.Refusal) as ctx:
            runner.retained_f_audit(self.c, self.config_sha, retained_audit='r3')
        self.assertIn('post-R419 wall ceiling', str(ctx.exception))
        self.c['limits']['F']['wall_seconds'] = 2546

        # Reset supervisor/cpu.stat (< 65462023) refuses
        with (
            patch.object(runner.signal, 'signal'),
            patch.object(runner.signal, 'setitimer'),
            patch.object(runner, '_cg_text', return_value='usage_usec 56990698\n'),
            patch.object(runner, 'consent'),
            patch.object(runner, 'supervisor_envelope'),
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(runner.Refusal) as ctx:
                runner.retained_f_audit(self.c, self.config_sha, retained_audit='r3')
            self.assertIn('supervisor CPU counter reset', str(ctx.exception))

        # Tampered consumed R419 r2 artifact refuses
        _write(self.packet / 'F_retained_audit_r2.stderr', b'tampered\n')
        with (
            patch.object(runner.signal, 'signal'),
            patch.object(runner.signal, 'setitimer'),
            patch.object(runner.resource, 'setrlimit'),
            patch.object(runner, '_cg_text', return_value='usage_usec 65462023\n'),
            patch.object(runner, 'consent'),
            patch.object(runner, 'supervisor_envelope'),
            patch.object(runner, 'bound_identities'),
            patch.object(runner, 'owned_paths'),
            patch.object(runner, 'quotas'),
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(runner.Refusal) as ctx:
                runner.retained_f_audit(self.c, self.config_sha, retained_audit='r3')
            self.assertIn('consumed R419 r2 predecessor digest mismatch', str(ctx.exception))
        _write(
            self.packet / 'F_retained_audit_r2.stderr',
            b'TERMINAL_REFUSAL: run-unit lacks dep-info-associated compiled build script\n',
        )

        # Success path on 'r3'
        timers = []
        rlimits = []

        def _fake_launch_r3(c, phase, sha, retained_audit=False):
            self.assertEqual(retained_audit, 'r3')
            _write(self.packet / 'F_RETAINED_QUARANTINED_OUTPUTS_R3.json', b'{"ok":true}\n')
            return {
                'phase': 'F',
                'processes': [{'argv': [], 'audit_worker': True, 'child_exit': 0}],
                'environment': {},
                'wall_seconds': 0.25,
                'log_bytes': {'stdout': 0, 'stderr': 10406},
            }

        clock = iter([100.0, 103.0, 103.5])
        with (
            patch.object(runner.time, 'monotonic', side_effect=lambda: next(clock)),
            patch.object(runner.signal, 'signal'),
            patch.object(runner.signal, 'setitimer', side_effect=lambda w, v: timers.append(v)),
            patch.object(runner.resource, 'setrlimit', side_effect=lambda r, v: rlimits.append(v)),
            patch.object(runner, '_cg_text', return_value='usage_usec 65462023\n'),
            patch.object(runner, 'consent'),
            patch.object(runner, 'supervisor_envelope'),
            patch.object(runner, 'bound_identities'),
            patch.object(runner, 'owned_paths'),
            patch.object(runner, 'quotas'),
            patch.object(runner, 'launch', side_effect=_fake_launch_r3),
        ):
            runner.retained_f_audit(self.c, self.config_sha, retained_audit='r3')

        self.assertEqual(timers[0], 2546)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(timers[1], 2546 - 3.0)
        self.assertEqual(timers[-1], 0)
        self.assertEqual(rlimits[0], (10800 - 66, 10800 - 66))

        res = runner.jload(self.packet / 'F_RETAINED_AUDIT_R3_RESULT.json')
        self.assertEqual(res['retained_audit'], 'r3')
        self.assertIs(res['native_outputs_accepted'], False)
        self.assertEqual(set(res['predecessors']), expected_keys)

        # Fresh-output exclusivity refusal when F_RETAINED_AUDIT_R3_RESULT.json already exists
        with (
            patch.object(runner.signal, 'signal'),
            patch.object(runner.signal, 'setitimer'),
            patch.object(runner.resource, 'setrlimit'),
            patch.object(runner, '_cg_text', return_value='usage_usec 65462023\n'),
            patch.object(runner, 'consent'),
            patch.object(runner, 'supervisor_envelope'),
            patch.object(runner, 'bound_identities'),
            patch.object(runner, 'owned_paths'),
            patch.object(runner, 'quotas'),
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(runner.Refusal) as ctx:
                runner.retained_f_audit(self.c, self.config_sha, retained_audit='r3')
            self.assertIn(
                'retained audit output already exists: F_RETAINED_AUDIT_R3_RESULT.json',
                str(ctx.exception),
            )
